title: SuggestionAccept
description: Request body for POST /suggestions/accept — the ONLY place a folder is created by the system (cluster-then-propose). Accepting a single suggestion files one save into an existing or new folder; accepting a cluster creates the folder and files every member. `dismissed_at` rejects a proposal permanently.

cluster.description: Required when type=cluster: the member saves shown on the proposal screen.

path.description: Proposed folder path (`Cooking / Pasta`); slashed per level.

accept.description: false records the dismissal (never re-proposed). Default accept.
